QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 2 (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: The Republicans need more promotional materials. What could they be?
QuestInfo.1: Cole's ex-assistant spilled their supply of printing ink in the Speaking Hall. Find them more replacement ink near the catering tables.
QuestInfo.2: You got the Red Ink Pot! Return to Cole.

0.0: One of my assistants was trying to sabotage me! He knocked over my ink pot while I was balancing it on my nose and now we can't print any promotional materials! Obviously, I fired him, but we still need that ink! I think there was some over by the catering tables...

yes.0: You really have the American spirit!

no.0: Do I have to fire you too?!

1.0: I knew you were a true patriot!

yes.0: You're a real red-blooded little helper! Keep this up, and I'll give you something great!

stop.0: Every bald eagle in America is going to cry when they find out how unhelpful you are.
